coordination_summary:
Six agent sessions have worked in this repository on 2026-10-22. arena/b4413b13-gold4 (PR #1, #3), arena/93da71b4-gold4 (PR #2) and arena/9614479d-gold4 (PR #4, #5) built the dataset, the site and the audit; arena/22b5b06c-gold4's review is preserved unmerged at docs/legacy/. Two sessions then re-verified the published tree line by line instead of trusting it: arena/fd51d093-gold4 (PR #7, Pass 4) and arena/e04b126a-gold4 (PR #10 and PR #13, Passes 5 and 6). The two passes were merged rather than stacked — where they disagreed, both readings are recorded and the disagreement is published on the Flagged page. Nothing from any other branch was deleted, renamed or force-pushed.
 Session arena/1372cb32-gold4 ran a concurrent independent pass (Pass 7 below): it re-read every official page behind the then-published rows, independently found the Anjolee 2.90 g weight and the VRAI pavé-spec behaviour, flagged Brilliant Earth currency localization after its 14K page served EUR on re-check, stated the derivation basis of the 15 U.S.C. 295 floors, and tightened every Mejuri price link to the exact variant URL where the price is displayed. When main advanced under it (PRs 7-15, then 17-19) it merged without discarding anything and kept only those unique deltas. Session arena/22b5b06c-gold4 later returned with its own independently collected dataset (15 Blue Nile / James Allen-line candidates and 4 Brilliant Earth candidates, 9 of them from live page fetches) plus a live gold-api.com spot reading; its integration merged main's published 47-row tree unchanged and added 17 rows to the same schema (PR #11), folding its 2 duplicate candidates into appended corroboration notes on BE-01 and BN-10, renumbering its ids to BE-05..BE-07 / BN-13..BN-26, and preserving its working files under data/preserved/, docs/legacy/ and scripts/session_22b5b06c/. Session arena/b2c018a8-gold4 independently re-read the branched-from 20-row tree line by line, corroborated the AN-01 weight, the Brilliant Earth price and the refreshed $4,028.53 benchmark, then merged main twice (through PRs #7–#21 + #11) keeping every merged value and carrying over two unique corrections: the VRAI band widths blanked as WIDTH_UNVERIFIED (no numeric width is published) and a copied sentence removed from VR-02's flag detail. | Pass 15 (arena/03c0c10f-gold4): first online source-health audit — 64 row URLs + 28 sources re-opened, 45 prices re-confirmed, 5 dead links and 7 bot-blocks flagged, Gate 6 added.
